column7: CreateShareRecord's re-share path persisted the share it had read with a full-row Save: a revoke committed between createShareRecordTx's lookup and its write was undone (Save's UPDATE ... WHERE deleted_at IS NULL matched nothing and GORM fell back to INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET deleted_at = NULL), so the same row id was live again with the re-share's permission. Both upsert paths now write permission/expires_at/updated_at through one conditional helper (reshareOntoLiveRow -> applyShareRequest) that re-runs the lookup once on a miss and otherwise fails closed with ErrShareNotFound. The test asserts the row in the database on SQLite (in-transaction interleave) and on Postgres (a second connection commits the revoke).
